title: Privacy Policy — Vote-Scope
description: Vote-Scope's privacy policy — no user accounts, no advertising profiles, no data sold. Plain language about what the site collects and why.
intro: VoteScope is an electoral projection site with no user accounts and no signup form. This page explains in plain language what is collected and why.
callout: In short: VoteScope does not sell your data, does not build advertising profiles and does not require an account. The site publishes public election analysis — that's it.

sections.title: What is collected automatically
sections.bodyHtml:
Like any website, our hosting provider may log standard connection data such as anonymized IP address, browser, visited pages and timestamps. This data is used only to measure overall audience and detect technical problems.

If analytics tools such as Plausible or Fathom (cookie-free, privacy-focused analytics) are enabled, this page will be updated to say so.

sections.title: Language preferences
sections.bodyHtml: The language choice (FR/EN) is saved in your browser localStorage. That preference never leaves your device and is only accessible to you.

sections.title: Third-party content
sections.bodyHtml: VoteScope may embed widgets from Polymarket (prediction markets) and links to Substack newsletters. These services have their own privacy policies — please consult them directly if you interact with them.

sections.title: Election data and polls
sections.bodyHtml: VoteScope projections are built from public polls and official data from Elections Canada, Elections Quebec and other public sources. No personal data is involved in producing the projections.

sections.title: Contact
sections.bodyHtml: For any question related to privacy or content: Kim Leclerc.
